references.text: Jesus responds to the announcement that his mother and brothers are standing outside wanting to speak with him by pointing to his disciples and defining them as his true family, based on doing God's will.
A similar event where Jesus' mother and brothers seek him out, and Jesus declares who his true family is.
Jesus is informed that his mother and brothers want to see him, and he responds by defining his true family as those who hear God's word and do it.
